# Matador Network

> > Matador Network is a travel media publication covering adventure travel, sustainable tourism, and cultural experiences worldwide.

This site features travel stories, destination guides, and photo essays exploring authentic experiences, from agricultural tourism in Grenada to adventure activities and cultural immersion around the globe. Content focuses on responsible travel and unique local experiences.

## Key Topics

- Grenada
- Grenada Chocolate Company
- Organic chocolate farming
- Cacao farming
- Bean-to-bar chocolate
- Agricultural tourism
- Sustainable travel
- Photo essays
- Caribbean travel
- Theobroma cacao
- Tourism Grenada
- Chocolate making process
- Dougaldston Spice Boucan

## Travel Photography & Photo Essays

- [Organic Chocolate Farming in Photos](https://matadornetwork.com/nights/organic-chocolate-farming-in-photos): Photo essay on organic cacao farming at Grenada Chocolate Company
